lots.title: Planned, Preventative and Responsive Residential Property Maintenance and Compliance Services (Measured Term Contract – JCT MTC 2024)
lots.description: Lot 10 of the London Borough of Bexley 6278 Building Services Framework, executed as a JCT Measured Term Contract 2024 between the Employer (London Borough of Bexley) and the Contractor. The Contract covers planned, preventative and responsive maintenance services to residential properties owned or managed by the London Borough of Bexley across approximately 230 Council-owned residential street properties, 120 privately leased properties managed by the Council, and 3 hostels (subject to variation during the Contract period). Works include responsive repairs and minor works, void property refurbishment, general building maintenance, engineering repairs, gas servicing and safety inspections, electrical inspection and testing, fire and Legionella compliance inspections, emergency repair call-out services, pest control, rubbish clearance and waste disposal, and asbestos reporting and management works. Initial Contract Term is 1 November 2026 – 31 October 2030 (4 years fixed term, no extension option). All works are instructed by the Contract Administrator through electronic works orders with priority-tiered response and completion SLAs.
requirements: Execute works under JCT Measured Term Contract 2024 incorporating Conditions of Contract, Contract Particulars, Schedule of Rates / Pricing Schedule, Contract Specification, and all associated contract documents.

Deliver services to approximately 230 Council-owned residential street properties, 120 privately leased properties managed by the Council, and 3 hostels, with the Employer reserving the right to vary the portfolio during the Contract period.

Commence no works until a valid electronic Order has been issued by the Contract Administrator; each Order to include description of works, priority category, property location, and cost allowance (where applicable).

Meet priority response and completion times: Standard – programmed / within 5 working days; Urgent – same or next day / within 1 working day; Emergency – immediate response, make safe within 4 hours; Small Void Works – within 10 working days; Large Void Works – within 28 working days. Emergency follow-on works to commence within 1 working day.

Operate monthly applications for payment with electronic invoice submission, a final date for payment of 30 days, VAT at the prevailing rate, and all invoices submitted within 6 months of order issue, in accordance with the Housing Grants, Construction and Regeneration Act 1996 and Section 4 of the JCT MTC 2024.

Undertake annual servicing of all gas appliances, carry out annual gas safety inspections, provide Landlord Gas Safety Records (LGSR), and provide a 24-hour breakdown service; all works to comply with the Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998.
Ensure all staff hold relevant trade qualifications, valid CSCS cards, photographic identification, and enhanced DBS clearance where required.
Dispose of all waste in accordance with the Environmental Protection Act 1990; be a registered waste carrier and provide waste transfer documentation upon request.

Comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015, act as Principal Contractor where required, and maintain SSIP accredited health and safety certification (e.g. CHAS).

Comply with all applicable statutory and regulatory requirements including Building Regulations 2010, Building Safety Act 2022, CDM Regulations 2015, Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations, IET Wiring Regulations BS 7671, Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order, Environmental Protection Act, and Data Protection legislation.

Measured Term Contract – Planned, Preventative and Responsive Residential Property Maintenance and Compliance Services
Initial Contract Term: 1 November 2026 – 31 October 2030; Duration: 4 Years Fixed Term; No extension option.

The Contract covers the provision of planned, preventative and responsive maintenance services to residential properties owned or managed by the London Borough of Bexley. The works include but are not limited to: Responsive repairs and minor works; Void property refurbishment works; General building maintenance; Engineering repairs; Gas servicing and safety inspections; Electrical inspection and testing; Fire and Legionella compliance inspections; Emergency repair call-out services; Pest control services; Rubbish clearance and waste disposal; Asbestos reporting and management works.

Approximately: 230 Council-owned residential street properties; 120 privately leased properties managed by the Council; 3 hostels requiring repairs and maintenance. The Employer reserves the right to vary the number of properties covered during the Contract period.

All works shall be instructed by the Contract Administrator through electronic works orders. Each Order will include: description of works, priority category, property location, cost allowance (where applicable). No works shall commence until a valid Order has been issued.

| Priority | Response Time | Completion | Standard | As programmed | Within 5 working days | Urgent | Same or next day | Within 1 working day | Emergency | Immediate | Make safe within 4 hours | Small Void Works | — | Within 10 working days | Large Void Works | — | Within 28 working days | Emergency follow-on works shall commence within 1 working day.

Payments shall be made in accordance with: Housing Grants, Construction and Regeneration Act 1996; Section 4 of the JCT Measured Term Contract 2024. Key provisions: Monthly applications for payment; Electronic submission of invoices; Final date for payment: 30 days; VAT payable at the prevailing rate; All invoices must be submitted within 6 months of order issue.

KPI 1 – Repair Response and Completion: Minimum 90% compliance with response and completion times. KPI 2 – Statutory Compliance and Property Safety: Maintain 100% statutory compliance across all properties; includes Gas Safety Certification, Electrical Safety Certification, Energy Performance Certification; Target: 100% compliance (Zero tolerance). KPI 3 – Void Turnaround and Property Readiness: Small voids within 10 working days; Large voids within 28 working days; Minimum 90% compliance measured monthly.

The Contractor shall comply with all applicable legislation including but not limited to: Building Regulations 2010; Building Safety Act 2022; CDM Regulations 2015; Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations; IET Wiring Regulations BS 7671; Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order; Environmental Protection Act; Data Protection legislation.

Comply with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974; Fulfil duties under the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015; Act as Principal Contractor where required; Maintain SSIP accredited health and safety certification (e.g. CHAS).

Undertake annual servicing of all gas appliances; Carry out annual gas safety inspections; Provide Landlord Gas Safety Records (LGSR); Provide a 24-hour breakdown service. All works must comply with the Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998.
All staff must: hold relevant trade qualifications; hold valid CSCS cards; carry photographic identification; hold enhanced DBS clearance where required.
All waste shall be disposed of in accordance with the Environmental Protection Act 1990. The Contractor must be a registered waste carrier and provide waste transfer documentation upon request.
